overview: The Medford City Council enacted administrative reorganization ordinances establishing chief of staff and chief procurement officer positions, and considered resolutions on municipal staffing and services. The council also engaged in lengthy discussion regarding school emergency notification protocols following a high school bomb threat before tabling the resolution.

items.title: Reorganization of Administrative Offices Ordinances
items.summary: The council passed four administrative ordinances on third reading establishing a two-year term for the city solicitor, creating chief of staff and chief procurement officer positions, and setting non-union compensation classifications.

items.title: Resolution on Public Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting minutes from municipal public meetings, with the council president noting they are published on the city website.

items.title: Resolution on School Bomb Threat Notification Policy
items.summary: Following extensive debate and public comment regarding parent communication during a recent Medford High School bomb threat, the council tabled a resolution asking the school committee to require immediate parental notifications for all threat levels.

items.title: Assessment of Street Signs and Hydrant Markers
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting an audit and replacement of faded street signs and hydrant markers, as well as consolidation of redundant signage.

items.title: Polling Places for Presidential Primary
items.summary: An order establishing polling locations and hours for the March 1, 2016 presidential primary election was approved.

items.title: DPW Staffing and Equipment Review
items.summary: The council approved a resolution directing the Public Works Subcommittee to investigate staffing levels and equipment needs within the Department of Public Works.

items.title: Inquiry on Veterans Welcome Home Bonus Data
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting historical data on local recipients of the Welcome Home bonus from 2001 to 2015 to assist in evaluating staffing needs for the Veterans Services office.

items.title: Princeton Street Tree Removal and Summer Calendar
items.summary: The council approved the removal of a hazardous tree on Princeton Street, set its 2016 summer meeting schedule, and approved amended minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Public Comment and Inquiry on Cemetery Green Burials
items.summary: Following public comment on Oak Grove Cemetery operations, the council approved a resolution requesting data from the Board of Cemetery Trustees on green burial requests and urging further study of eco-friendly burial options.
